title: optical sync refinement core
description:
GY-04: refine the frame-IMU clock offset optically, starting
from the existing wall-clock anchor (never re-anchoring). The
shipped anchor is a receive-wall-clock estimate with an
ASSUMED +/-25 ms bound; a constant sync error makes the
stabilization correction fight motion instead of canceling it.

core/src/OpticalSync.cpp + core/include/rawedit/OpticalSync.h
(image-side math, I/O-free; Sync.cpp untouched):
- refineOffsetOptically(anchor, frames, orientationSeries,
  intrinsics, opts): search +/-150 ms around the anchor at 1 ms
  (301 candidates), then refine the best at 0.1 ms over +/-2 ms.
- per candidate: t_imu = repTime + offset; quaternion from the
  RAW orientation series via orientationAt (SLERP, clamped);
